response.justification: The candidate is a versatile, experienced polyglot engineer with strong software-craftsmanship fundamentals and some genuine high-scale experience (low-latency ad-tech services handling millions of requests per second), but the resume shows no evidence of the role's core domain: experimentation platforms, A/B testing, feature flighting, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, or growth engineering. Additionally, most recent roles are senior/staff IC positions at small-to-mid-size companies without the multi-workstream, cross-org technical leadership expected at a Principal/IC6 level, making the fit weak despite solid engineering credentials.
strengths: 15+ years of hands-on engineering across web, backend, mobile, and embedded, with a CS degree and strong testing/TDD culture
Real high-scale distributed systems experience (low-latency services handling millions of HTTP requests/sec at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic)
Recent AI tooling exposure (MCP code generators, agentic workflow frameworks) matching the AI-first emphasis
concerns: No demonstrated experience with experimentation frameworks, A/B testing, feature flagging, or growth measurement systems — the core of this role
No evidence of Principal-level scope: leading multi-team initiatives, platform adoption across orgs, or stakeholder alignment at enterprise scale
Limited signal on statistical analysis, metrics/guardrail design, or telemetry infrastructure ownership

key_factors.factor: Strong engineering fundamentals and scale experience
